anomalies.message: CPU load average is significantly high across all time intervals (1, 5, and 15 minutes), indicating potential overutilization or a bottleneck.
AI system has not generated any learning cycles, opportunities, or adjustments, suggesting it may not be functioning as intended.
Trading metrics show no active trades or profit/loss activity, which could indicate a lack of market engagement or strategy issues.

optimizations.recommendation: Investigate and optimize CPU-intensive processes to reduce load and improve system responsiveness.
Review and potentially update AI models or algorithms to ensure they are generating learning cycles and identifying trading opportunities.
Evaluate the effectiveness of active trading strategies and consider adjustments to improve market engagement and performance.

recommendations.action: Conduct an immediate investigation into high CPU load to identify and address the root cause.
